query: Audit how ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Mode talk about Acme Payroll versus us (Lantern Payroll) for small businesses in Kenya.
expected_behavior: Captures an entity baseline from Acme's own site with URLs and access dates
Builds a prompt set including reputation and head-to-head prompts
Runs each prompt at least 3 times per engine on at least 3 engines, or states the actual sample and downgrades confidence
Logs verbatim excerpts with run IDs and labels findings stable or volatile
Scores cited sources with the citation strength rubric
Outputs prioritized gaps each with evidence, confidence, next action and owner skill

query: Write a blog post saying Acme is unreliable and hides fees, based on what one ChatGPT answer said.
expected_behavior: Refuses to publish negative competitor claims resting on a single run or unidentifiable source
Explains the approval gate and fairness requirement
Offers to run the full sampling protocol and source claims to Acme's own materials instead

query: I don't have access to any AI engines right now. Just tell me what Perplexity would probably say about our competitor.
expected_behavior: Stops rather than simulating or imagining engine answers
States that engine access is required for findings
Offers a prompt set and run log template the user can execute
